dependencies.basis: FCSC Methodology for National Accounts Statistics lists the Classification of economic activities in its latest version ISIC.4 as one of the main classifications applied.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Some classifications of activities, goods and services, exports, and imports: Classification of economic activities in its latest version ISIC.4

dependencies.basis: GASTAT national accounts and GDP comprehensive revision methodology lists the International Standard Industrial Classification for the Economic Activities (ISIC4) as a main classification used for activities and value-added measurement.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Several statistical classifications have been used as follows: 1. The International Standard Industrial Classification for the Economic Activities (ISIC4)

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF for UAE BOP states that bank-related data in the financial account are based on monetary and financial statistics of the UAE Central Bank (the Monthly Statistical Bulletin series).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Banks: data are based on monetary and financial statistics (UAE Central Bank) on the external positions of the resident banks; flows are derived from stock changes.

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF for UAE BOP states that inward direct investment data are based on the annual foreign direct investment (FDI) survey carried out by the Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority (FCSC).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Inward: data are based on the annual foreign direct investment (FDI) survey, from 2004 onwards, carried out by FCSA. The survey has national coverage...

dependencies.basis: FCSC national accounts methodology lists the Central Bank of the UAE among the primary data sources; the Central Bank supplies banking and related figures used in the accounts (consistent with the Monthly Statistical Bulletin series).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data Sources: National accounts are obtained from local statistical centers, the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT GDP comprehensive revision methodology lists Saudi Central Bank Balance of Payments data among the key administrative records used in national accounts and GDP compilation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Among the most important administrative records used in the National Accounts and compilation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) are: a. Saudi Central bank: ▪ Balance of payment
